characters.name: Cocardo
characters.role: Protagonist and main villain. He owns the ice-cream shop 'Coco's Scoops' and is Lima's partner ('amor'). After Lima is frozen by accident he turns frozen fruit women into ice-cream flavours to fill Don Piña's order. He partners with Cherry (Cereza). In Part 13 the thawed victims and Banano defeat him and he is arrested.
characters.appearance: STYLE: glossy Pixar-like 3D AI CGI. HEAD: the whole head is a large oval brown coconut, wider at the crown. It has a hairy husk with loose fibre strands and THREE dark round coconut 'eyes' (holes) on top. FACE: an adult human male face set into the front of the coconut, coconut-brown and smoother than the husk. Big glossy brown eyes; thick, very expressive dark-brown/black eyebrows; broad nose; human lips with white teeth. Typical expressions: scheming smirk, wide salesman grin, wide-eyed panic. No mustache and no separate beard. The fibrous husk texture wraps the jaw, chin and neck and reads as coconut-fibre stubble. BODY: broad-shouldered and muscular, with brown arms and hands covered in fuzzy coconut-fibre hair. OUTFIT (constant in all 13 parts): plain olive/army-green crew-neck T-shirt. Off-white/cream apron with thin vertical grey pinstripes and a front pocket holding spoons/pens. A round 'COCO'S SCOOPS' logo on the chest: brown circular lettering around a half-coconut bowl holding three scoops (pink, teal, yellow) and a small palm tree. A small white name tag reading 'COCO' (AI sometimes garbles it to 'COCB', 'COCD' or 'COOS'). Blue jeans and white sneakers. ACCESSORIES: black (smart)watch on the left wrist and thin beaded/cord bracelets. PROPS: a steel ice-cream scoop (also his weapon in Parts 12-13), smartphone, order notebook and pen. No hat. ALTERNATE LOOKS: frost-covered and pale blue in Cherry's daydream (Part 9). In jail (last shot of Part 13): brown Hannibal-Lecter-style face/mouth mask, cream straitjacket and orange prison trousers. NOT CANON: fan thumbnails with a kitchen knife and evil grin; the green-polo 'Cocardo'-sign shop variant in a TuNota collage.
characters.personality: Starts as a broke, deadpan joker ('Bueno, entonces mañana prende menos luces'; 'No está viejo, está experimentado') and a charming salesman ('es orgánico, más de lo que imaginas'). He turns greedy, calculating and cold. He apologises while scraping Lima ('perdóname amor, solo un poquito') and calls the frozen girls 'inventario'. Later he becomes paranoid and controlling: he installs cameras, refuses a second branch, and tells Cherry 'yo tenía el control antes de que llegaras'. He is cruel in the fight ('helado de plátano con chocolate').
characters.story_arc: P1: buys a cheap used freezer (4,000 pesos, 5,000 with shipping). Lima is trapped in it. He finds her frozen but alive ('¡no inventes, estás viva!'), scrapes her and sells 'helado de Lima limón'. Her arm regenerates. P2: freezes Lima's cousin Fresa ('lo siento Fresa, pero te necesito'). P3: Don Piña orders 500 L per flavour and demands 5 flavours. P4: a bigger freezer arrives; he moves 'el inventario' and freezes Durazna ('estoy a tres sabores de cerrar el mejor trato de mi vida... tú serás el tercero... tres de 5'). P5: lures Uva and Banana with a fake job at closing time ('Perfecto, ya están los 5'). P6: Cherry finds the freezer and becomes his partner. P7: Cherry freezes Naranja without asking him and he is angry ('no puedes traer gente aquí sin consultarme... métela en el congelador viejo'). P8: a blackout lets Uva escape and Cherry recaptures her. Piña's order is late. P9: power struggle with Cherry. P10: spots Banano's car, installs cameras, refuses a second branch. P11: panics as Banano closes in. P12: Banano drives his car into the shop and they fight ('te vas a reunir con ella pronto... helado de plátano con chocolate'). P13: the victims thaw ('se están descongelando'). Lima ends it ('ya no más'). He is knocked out, handcuffed by a watermelon cop and reported on TV ('Cocardo, dueño de la famosa heladería, fue arrestado esta noche'). Last shot: in a cell in straitjacket and mask while a shadowy figure walks toward it (cliffhanger). NOT CANON: a prison escape in a police uniform and hiding in a police station (El Gráfico 5 Oct; cocardo.com 'Estado: Escapó de prisión'), which matches fan continuations; and the 'Cocardo murió' death hoaxes.
characters.conflicts: (1) Facial hair: two researchers saw coconut-fibre stubble on the jaw and one said clean-shaven. All five agree there is no mustache. In a creator frame I checked, the husk fibre texture covers the jaw, with no separate beard or mustache. (2) Job: TuNota once calls him 'un vendedor de frutas' but elsewhere 'dueño de una heladería'. The videos show the ice-cream shop owner. (3) Fate: the creator's Part 13 ends with him in jail. El Gráfico (5 Oct) and cocardo.com say he escaped prison disguised as a policeman. That is not in the creator's 13 parts and matches fan continuations. (4) His death ('Falleció Cocardo, el famoso heladero': car crash, frozen, shot, fake funerals) is a hoax, debunked by Radio HRN, Exitosa, Milenio, El Comercio, DSN and cocardo.com. (5) Who supplied the big freezer: most reports say Cocardo bought or ordered it, one says Don Piña sent it. The broccoli delivery man installs it either way.

characters.name: Lima
characters.fruit: Lima (lime). Her flavour is sold as 'helado de Lima limón' / 'la nieve de Lima'.
characters.role: Cocardo's girlfriend ('amor') and partner in the shop. She is the first victim, trapped by accident in the old freezer, and her frozen body becomes the signature flavour that gives the series its title, 'La Nieve de Lima'. She stays alive and conscious while frozen, and scraped parts regenerate. She is Fresa's cousin, and she is thawed and freed in Part 13.
characters.appearance: A stylised young woman with a curvy figure and human face, in the same 3D Pixar-like style. SKIN: lime green all over, with tiny lighter yellow-green dots like citrus-peel pores. HAIR: long, voluminous, wavy green hair of leaf-like strands, decorated with leaves, small round green buds/limes and tiny white blossoms. EYES: big almond-shaped amber/hazel-golden eyes with long lashes. EYEBROWS: dark green and arched. LIPS: dark green and full. JEWELLERY: gold hoop earrings, thin gold necklace(s) with a small pendant, a wristwatch in some shots. OUTFIT: cream/off-white ribbed short-sleeve fitted crop T-shirt (midriff visible), blue denim shorts (long jeans in some shots, an AI inconsistency), light sandals (one report says wedge sandals). FROZEN: frost-covered, pale frosty blue-green with blank white eyes, sitting hugging her knees inside the old upright freezer. FINALE: thawed, with a calm, sad expression.
characters.personality: Practical, money-minded and sceptical. She scolds Cocardo about the junk freezer ('hace ruidos raros, tiembla solo y huele a quemado'; 'esa cosa nos va a salir carísimo'). Affectionate at first; hurt and decisive in the finale.
characters.story_arc: P1: 'Cocardo, hoy vendemos menos de lo que cuesta prender las luces.' She goes into the freezer to check the cable, the door slams ('Lima, hazte para atrás, no abre' / 'Ya sé, ya sé, Cocardo, tengo frío'), and she is found frozen but alive. Scraped into ice cream, her arm grows back ('tu brazo... se regeneró'). P2: Cocardo complains 'ya me están dejando sin brazo'. Her cousin Fresa comes looking for her. P4: moved to the big freezer. P9: still being scraped ('raspa más rápido'). P13: thaws. Cocardo says 'Lima. Mi amor, eres tú'; the reply 'Ya no más' is probably hers, and she hits him. Afterwards she talks with Fresa outside the wrecked shop ('No puedo creer todo lo que hizo Cocardo... A veces lo descubres demasiado tarde').
characters.conflicts: (1) Clothing alternates between denim shorts and long jeans across shots (AI inconsistency); most shots show shorts. (2) The subtitles have no speaker labels. Splitting 'Lima. Mi amor, eres tú' (Cocardo) from 'Ya no más' (Lima) is inferred from frames, and one report gave the whole line to Lima. The closing 'A veces lo descubres demasiado tarde' is a Lima-and-Fresa exchange, and who says which line is uncertain. (3) No conflict on regeneration: the video dialogue ('tu brazo se regeneró') agrees with MTP and Exitosa.

characters.name: Cherry (Cereza)
characters.role: A customer who becomes Cocardo's partner/accomplice ('socia') and then his rival; she is the business brain. She discovers the frozen girls and offers to build an 'imperio', gets Don Piña to pay triple, freezes her own neighbour Naranja, recaptures the escaped Uva and pushes for a second branch. In the creator's finale she escapes by plane while the police search for her. Everyone on screen calls her 'Cherry'; Spanish press and fans call her 'Cereza'.
characters.appearance: SKIN: deep cherry red, very glossy and candy-like. HEAD: a single long cherry stem with one green leaf sprouting from the top centre of her head; it pokes through her sun hat at the airport. HAIR: long, wavy, centre-parted, in alternating streaks of dark forest green and burgundy/dark red. EYES: large amber/golden-brown with heavy winged lashes, glowing red in villain close-ups. EYEBROWS: dark red-brown and arched. LIPS: dark burgundy and glossy, usually a sly smirk. JEWELLERY: small gold hoops; layered gold necklaces with small coin/pendant charms; stacked multicolour beaded bracelets and gold bangles. MAIN OUTFIT: black ribbed crop tank top, white denim shorts with small rips, red heels. OFFICE FLASHBACK: glasses, white shirt, black tie, black pencil skirt. ESCAPE LOOK (P13): wide-brim white/cream sun hat, large black sunglasses, fitted white/cream short-sleeve dress with lace-trimmed sleeves, gold watch, layered gold necklaces, heels, black rolling suitcase. She pays for a plane ticket with a stack of dollars. In Banano's file she appears in a photo wearing a straitjacket. NOT CANON: the dark-haired Cherry in the Merca2.0 fan illustration; the pregnant Cherry of the fan 'Temporada 2'.
characters.personality: Ambitious, seductive, cold, manipulative and impulsive. Her office job bored her ('papeles, sellos, sonrisas falsas'). She thinks big ('el problema es que siempre piensas en pequeño') and wants 'otra sucursal'. Dark humour ('¿Y helado de coco cremosito? ...Bromi'). Possibly unhinged: Banano's file says 'estuvo encerrada en una institución mental hace años'.
characters.story_arc: P1 (frames, medium confidence): the first customer to taste the Lima ice cream. P5: a cherry flavour comes up at the counter ('oye, ¿y a ti no te gustaría uno de cereza?' / '¿en serio harías eso?' / 'creo que podríamos arreglarlo fácil'). P6: 'Estuve pensando en lo que me dijiste... lo del helado de cereza, quiero que lo hagas.' Cocardo: 'Hoy no es buen momento... Cherry, no abra ese congelador.' She opens it anyway: 'Mira, ahí está Banana, hola Banana... esto es hermoso... ¿de aquí salen los sabores? Cocardo, esto es fantástico, quiero trabajar contigo... tienes 5 sabores que nadie más puede hacer... tú haces el helado, yo te ayudo a convertir esto en un imperio.' P6-7: 'Espere, queremos el triple de lo que ofreció'; 'No me hizo socia, yo vi una oportunidad'; she pitches melón, mango and her neighbour, then jokes about coconut ice cream. Backstory segment. She freezes Naranja ('buenas noches, naranjita') and defends it ('es insoportable, solo quise darle un uso... funcionó, ¿no?'). P8: Uva escapes. Cherry finds her in the rain ('tranquila, ya estás afuera... ven conmigo, yo te ayudo'), then 'aquí termina el paseo... se acabó, Uva'. P9: 'No, Cocardo, tenías suerte'; daydreams about freezing Cocardo and selling 'helado de coco'. P10: pushes for a second branch. P11: 'deja de temblar y piensa'. P12: tries to restore the freezers' power and swings a metal tray; Banano knocks her out ('una menos'). P13: 'El culpable son dos... Cherry'. TV news: 'las autoridades buscan a su compañera Cherry, quien aparentemente escapó de la escena'. At the airport: 'Un boleto de avión, por favor.' Don Piña: 'Cherry... interesante.'
characters.conflicts: (1) Name: 'Cherry' in every line of dialogue, the police report and the TV news; 'Cereza' in press and fan usage. The Gallelatto real-shop cut-out says 'Cherry'. (2) Customer or employee: four researchers say customer, and Cocardo addresses her with formal 'usted' ('no abra'). One said she was hired at closing time; that is a minority reading. (3) Who suggested the cherry flavour is ambiguous in the subtitles. One report gives the line to Cherry, another says Cocardo considered using her. Her later 'lo que me dijiste' suggests Cocardo floated it, perhaps as bait for a sixth flavour. (4) ENDING: in the creator's Part 13 she flees by plane and is wanted by police. TuNota (25 Sep, written before Parts 10-13 existed) says she framed Cocardo with fake evidence, planted illegal goods and took over the shop. El Gráfico (5 Oct) says she 'quedó libre y tomó el control del negocio'. La Unión says she 'consigue huir', which matches the video. Fan-only versions: pregnant in Los Angeles planning a rescue (@frutinovelassell 'Temporada 2'); freezing Cocardo and freeing the girls (an @stories.seriesof segment inside @sisoyfrosti's compilation). (5) Part 12 tray: one report says she hit Banano with a steel tray, two say she blocked him with it before he knocked her out. (6) Escape outfit: heels red in two reports and black in one; dress white or cream. (7) The mental-institution file is about Cherry: the subtitles have Banano say 'lo sabía... esa mujer estaba loca, estuvo encerrada en una institución mental hace años', and a frame shows her photo in a straitjacket. One researcher wrongly attached the line to Naranja.

characters.name: Banano
characters.role: The hero and investigator. He is the (older) brother of the victim Banana and is searching for his missing sister. Police call him 'un investigador', captions call him 'el detective', and La Unión calls him 'un policía'. He follows the evidence, rams his car into the shop, fights Cocardo and Cherry, and reunites with Banana.
characters.appearance: HEAD: a single tall, elongated whole banana, yellow with brown ripeness speckles and bruise marks, with a curved dark-brown stem tip on top. FACE: a rugged adult human male face with thick, furrowed dark-brown brows, deep-set brown eyes and a strong nose. FACIAL HAIR: a full, thick black beard and mustache. BODY: very muscular. His forearms are covered in black script-lettering tattoos, and his hands are yellow banana skin (AI renders one hand dark brown in P13). OUTFIT: white dress shirt with rolled sleeves and open collar; loosened skinny black tie; black trousers; black (combat) boots; wristwatch. PROPS: black classic 1960s-style muscle car. A night office desk with a city-skyline window, a newspaper headline about missing fruit women ('MUJERES FRUTA DESAPARECIDAS' / 'Fruta Desaparecida') with his sister's photo, case files and polaroids, a notepad, a phone with his sister's photo, and a CCTV monitor. NOT CANON: the SWAT or police gear in fan continuations.
characters.personality: Stubborn, tough, blunt lone wolf and a protective brother. He ignores police warnings ('seguir gente, meterte donde no debes, terminar golpeado') and speaks in dry one-liners ('solo quiero respuestas'; 'acércate y averígualo'). He is visibly getting older ('todavía sé pegar, pero cada vez más despacio').
characters.story_arc: P5/6: reads the missing-women newspaper ('Otra vez no... están desapareciendo chicas en esta ciudad, y esto me resulta demasiado familiar'; 'Dónde estás, hermana. Voy a encontrarte'). P7: at the shop counter ('primera vez por aquí? / sí, mi hermana venía seguido... estoy buscando a mi hermana'), Cherry serves him plátano ('demasiado familiar... mi hermana también era banana... ¿de dónde sacan la fruta?'). He then finds Cherry's mental-institution file. P9 'La Grabación': tails Don Piña's Rolls-Royce, scuffles with the bodyguard ('solo quiero respuestas'), and reviews CCTV of Uva leaving a store with Cherry ('Uva... así que estabas ahí... ¿qué demonios tienen ahí atrás?'). P10: stakeout; the homeless lemon tips him off. P11: finds Banana's bracelet behind the shop ('esta pulsera se la regalé yo... hermana, estuviste aquí'), shows it to the strawberry officer, and drives to the shop. P12: crashes his car through the shop wall, cutting the freezers' power ('así que tú eres Cocardo... ¿dónde está mi hermana?'), knocks Cherry out ('una menos') and fights Cocardo. P13: pinned down by Cocardo ('te llegó la hora... los años ya te están pesando'), then saved when the girls thaw. 'El culpable son dos... Cherry.' Reunion: 'Siempre iba a venir por ti.'
characters.conflicts: (1) El Comercio, Milenio (as cited) and cocardo.com merge him with his sister ('una banana investiga lo ocurrido'). In the videos the investigator is the bearded male Banano and Banana is a victim; El Gráfico (5 Oct) gets this right. (2) Police officer or private investigator: La Unión (read only through a search snippet, page 403) says 'un policía'. In the dialogue a police officer scolds him and the station calls him 'un investigador que acaba de meterse en problemas', so he is probably not a serving officer. Unresolved. (3) In P9, 'ya estoy muy viejo para esto' comes during the Banano-versus-bodyguard scuffle. One report gave it to Banano and another to Don Piña. (4) 'El culpable son dos' (P13) was attributed to Banano by two reports and to the police by two.

characters.name: Don Piña
characters.role: A millionaire businessman and the shop's big buyer. His order (500 L per flavour, 5 flavours, later at triple price) drives the kidnappings. He says he doesn't care where the product comes from. He is never a victim in the creator's videos.
characters.appearance: HEAD: a whole pineapple with a tall, spiky green leafy crown. The face and hands are golden-yellow/orange with diamond-scale pineapple texture. A handsome adult human male face: dark/brown eyebrows, warm brown eyes, squarish jaw, a confident smirk or stern look (one report notes short stubble). OUTFIT: burgundy/maroon three-piece suit (jacket, vest, trousers), white shirt, burgundy/dark-red tie with a silver tie clip, gold pocket square, black dress shoes, wristwatch and gold ring. PROPS: arrives in a black Rolls-Royce. He eats ice cream from a glass coupe or cone and pays with black briefcases full of US-dollar bundles. Whisky glass in a dark wood-panelled mansion office with a TV (he smashes the glass in P13). His bald bodyguard is always with him. NOT CANON: gold chains, seen only in a segment that is probably fan-made.
characters.personality: Smooth, cold, demanding and purely transactional ('Y no hables'; 'mientras cumplan con el pedido no es asunto mío'; 'creí que eras un hombre de palabra' / 'los malos hábitos sí'). After the arrest he only worries about his orders.
characters.story_arc: P3: '¿Tú eres Cocardo?' / 'Depende quién pregunte.' / 'Don Piña... he escuchado demasiado sobre tu helado de Lima... empiece con el de Lima. Y no hables.' After tasting: '¿Qué demonios estás haciendo aquí vendiendo esto por vasitos? ¿Cuánto puedes producir al día? Necesito 500 l para empezar... 500 por sabor... Consígueme 5 y tenemos un trato.' P5: '¿Cómo van mis nuevos sabores?' P6/7: tastes all 5. Cherry says 'queremos el triple', and he answers 'me agradas, denos el triple'. He brings a briefcase of cash ('estas son sus ganancias del primer pedido') and says 'empiezo a entender por qué la hiciste tu socia.' P8: the order is late ('una falla eléctrica'): 'así no funciona... creí que eras un hombre de palabra' / 'Una noche de retraso no va a destruir su imperio' / 'No, pero los malos hábitos sí.' P9: Banano tails and questions him: 'tengo negocios por toda la ciudad... mientras cumplan con el pedido no es asunto mío.' P13: watching the news with whisky, smashes his glass: '¡Idiota! Tenía un negocio que funcionaba y consiguió que lo arrestaran... me preocupa que mañana tengo pedidos y nadie que los produzca... Cherry... interesante.'
characters.conflicts: (1) Victim or not: TuNota's 'quien-es-cocardo' article lists 'la Piña' among the victims. One researcher traced this to a fan 'La Nieve de Lima parte 9 El Helado Multi-Sabor' by @verdugo_frutisnovela (@frutirelatoss_), where Piña is frozen. He is never a victim in the creator's videos. (2) Gender: cocardo.com once writes 'empresaria millonaria'; the videos and other outlets show a man. (3) Watch: silver in one report, gold in another. (4) Some reports say Cocardo bought the big freezer, one says Piña sent it. (5) 'Muy viejo para esto' was attributed to him by one report; it is more likely Banano's (see Banano). (6) Fan 'Temporada 2' (non-canon): he summons Cherry to New York ('Cocardo ya es historia, pero tu fórmula sigue viva').

characters.name: Fresa (some outlets: 'Fresita')
characters.role: The second victim and second flavour ('el nuevo sabor de fresa', sold as a 'receta familiar'). She is Lima's cousin and is thawed and freed in Part 13. She is a different character from the strawberry-HEADED police officer.
characters.appearance: SKIN: bright strawberry red (red-to-pink), dotted with many tiny pale-yellow seeds on the face, arms and legs. HAIR: long bright grass-green hair with a short, spiky leafy crown on top like a strawberry calyx, and choppy bangs. EYES: large, green or green-grey. EYEBROWS: green. LIPS: pinkish red. OUTFIT: white/cream tank or sweetheart/corset crop top, white shorts, pink sandals; in the finale, a white top with white trousers. JEWELLERY: thin gold necklace with a small pendant, gold hoops. FROZEN: frosty pink with white-blue blank eyes, hugging her knees in the old freezer.
characters.personality: A loyal, worried cousin who came to check on Lima. She says little before she is captured, and in the finale she reflects on what happened with Lima.
characters.story_arc: P2: arrives late at night: 'Vine a ver a mi prima Lima, no me responde desde ayer.' Cocardo: 'Está ocupada... acá atrás... ven, te la voy a mostrar.' Fresa: '¡Oh por Dios, Lima! ¿Qué está pasando aquí?' Cocardo: 'Lo siento Fresa, pero te necesito.' He shuts her in; La Razón's summary says he hits her first. Cocardo: 'Fantástico, ya tengo un nuevo sabor para mañana.' P3: 'Mi amor Lima y su prima Fresa, ¿qué haría yo sin ustedes?' / 'tenemos la famosa nieve de Lima y el nuevo sabor de fresa.' P13: thaws, surrounds Cocardo with the other girls, and afterwards talks with Lima outside the shop.
characters.conflicts: (1) Whose cousin: MTP Noticias says 'prima de Cocardo' (ambiguous wording). The dialogue ('mi prima Lima'; 'Lima y su prima Fresa') makes her LIMA's cousin. (2) Shorts: red/white in one report, white in three. (3) Eye colour: green or green-grey. (4) A YouTube thumbnail showing a red-haired strawberry girl is re-generated fan art, not canon.

characters.name: Durazna (also written Durazno / Duraznita)
characters.role: The third victim and third flavour ('durazno'). She is a regular customer whom Cocardo lures to the back as a recipe tester with the promise of 'helado gratis de por vida'. She thaws in Part 13 and fights back.
characters.appearance: SKIN: peach, with a golden-orange base and strong pink-red blush gradients on the cheeks, nose, shoulders and knees, plus a small vertical peach crease at the forehead/crown. HEAD: a short brown peach stem with one or two green leaves on top centre. HAIR: long, wavy, dark forest-green hair with a centre part. EYES: big and green. EYEBROWS: thick and dark green. LIPS: mauve-pink. JEWELLERY: gold hoop earrings, layered gold necklaces, bracelets. OUTFIT: white fitted V-neck crop tank (a light-blue tank in one close-up) and blue denim shorts. FINALE: angry, holding a metal bar/pipe with a blue handle.
characters.personality: Friendly, flirty and trusting at the counter, then terrified ('¿qué les hiciste?... ¡estás loco!... déjame salir'). She fights back in the finale.
characters.story_arc: P4: Cocardo invites her: 'quiero probar unas recetas nuevas... helado gratis de por vida.' In the back ('aquí empieza el menú') she sees the others: '¿Qué hacen Lima y Fresa ahí?... ¿Qué les hiciste?' Cocardo: 'Lo mismo que necesito hacerte a ti... Estoy a tres sabores de cerrar el mejor trato de mi vida... tú serás el tercero... tranquila, será rápido... no puedo, te necesito... tres de 5.' Next day a customer says 'este de durazno está buenísimo.' P8: named in Cocardo's freezer roll call ('Lima, fresa, durazno, banana... ¿dónde está Uva?'). P13: thawed, armed with a metal pipe, she helps take Cocardo down.
characters.conflicts: (1) NAME: the press mostly says 'Durazna' (TuNota, DSN, MTP, Exitosa, El Gráfico 5 Oct). 'Durazno' appears in El Gráfico 11 Oct, on cocardo.com and in the P8 roll call as auto-transcribed ('Lima fresa durazno banana'). cocardo.com says TuNota uses 'Duraznita'. The flavour is always 'durazno'. Whether her on-screen name is 'Durazna' or 'Durazno' is unresolved, because the auto-captions may not catch the -a/-o ending. Confidence for the character is high; for the exact name it is medium. (2) Her finale weapon was described as a bar, a mop/pole, a bat/stick, a metal bar with a blue handle, and a pipe; the most specific description is the metal bar/pipe with a blue handle.

characters.name: Uva
characters.fruit: Uva (purple grape; the flavour is 'uva' / 'uva morada')
characters.role: A victim and the 'uva' flavour. She is new in town and looking for work, and Cocardo lures her with a job at closing time. She thaws during a blackout and escapes, but Cherry tricks her and brings her back to be refrozen. She is freed in Part 13.
characters.appearance: SKIN: deep violet/grape purple and glossy, with darker purple mottled speckles like a grape's bloom. HAIR: long dark-green (green-grey) hair woven with large grape leaves and curly vine tendrils. EYES: large and warm brown. EYEBROWS: dark green/purple. LIPS: mauve-pink. OUTFIT: cream/white sweetheart-neckline bustier crop top, white shorts, lilac/white platform sandals or heels. JEWELLERY: thin gold necklace, gold and beaded bracelets. ESCAPE LOOK: soaked, with frost and water droplets, shivering and hugging herself.
characters.personality: Sweet, hopeful and trusting at first; later terrified and desperate ('por favor no me encuentre').
characters.story_arc: P5: 'Oye espera, ¿eres nueva por aquí? Nunca te había visto' / 'Llegué hace unos días... sigo buscando trabajo' / 'Qué coincidencia... justo necesito ayuda en la heladería, pásate esta noche a la hora del cierre.' At closing she arrives with Banana. 'Entren y véanlo de cerca' / 'Espera, esas son... ¿qué demonios?' She is frozen ('ya están los 5'). P8 'La Fuga': a storm cuts the power. 'Lima, fresa, durazno, banana... ¿dónde está Uva?' / 'Uva se descongeló lo suficiente para salir.' She hides among boxes and runs through the rain into a store. To Cherry: 'Ayúdame por favor... un hombre me encerró en un congelador, llevo no sé cuánto tiempo ahí dentro.' Back at the shop: '¿Por qué volvemos aquí?' / 'Porque aquí termina el paseo.' / '¡Tú estás con él!' / 'Sí. Se acabó, Uva.' She is refrozen. P9: Banano finds the CCTV footage of her leaving with Cherry ('La Grabación'). P13: thaws and is freed.
characters.conflicts: (1) Victim number: she and Banana are frozen together in the same closing-time scene. Reports number her as 4th (three reports) or 5th (two reports). Freezing order: Lima, Fresa, Durazna, then Uva and Banana together, then Naranja. (2) Hair: dark green in most reports, dark green-grey in one.

characters.name: Banana
characters.fruit: Banana (female; the flavour is sold as 'plátano')
characters.role: A victim and the 'plátano' flavour, and the younger sister of the investigator Banano. She is a regular customer who was fired 'yesterday', and Cocardo lures her with a job offer. The bracelet she lost behind the shop proves she was there. She is freed and reunited with her brother in Part 13.
characters.appearance: SKIN: pale banana yellow with small brown freckle spots like ripening marks, and pink blush on the cheeks. HAIR: long, very voluminous hair shaped like peeled banana-skin strips curling outward, golden yellow outside and cream/white inside, with some dark-brown tips. EYES: large green/olive (one report: green or blue) with heavy lashes. EYEBROWS: olive-brown. LIPS: glossy pink. JEWELLERY: gold hoop earrings, layered gold necklaces with a coin pendant, and a gold bracelet with banana charm(s) that her brother gave her. OUTFIT: cream/white tank top, light-blue denim shorts. FROZEN: frosted white with blank pale eyes.
characters.personality: Bubbly, cheerful and chatty; a trusting regular customer.
characters.story_arc: P5: 'Hola Cocardo, me das uno de Lima' / 'Qué suerte la tuya, a mí me despidieron ayer... venir por uno de estos helados al menos me alegra el día' / '¿Me estás ofreciendo trabajo?' Cocardo writes 'Plátano ????' on his notepad. At closing she arrives with Uva and is frozen. P6: Cherry finds her frozen: 'Mira, ahí está Banana, hola Banana.' P7: 'Se nos está acabando el de plátano' / 'habrá que raspar un poquito más.' P11: Banano finds her bracelet behind the shop. P13: thawed, she helps her brother ('Banano, ¿estás bien?'). Reunion: 'Pensé que no iba a volver a verte... Gracias por venir por mí' / 'Siempre iba a venir por ti.'
characters.conflicts: (1) Role: El Comercio, Milenio (as cited) and cocardo.com say 'Banana' investigates the disappearances. In the videos she is a victim and the investigator is her brother Banano (El Gráfico 5 Oct agrees with the videos). (2) Victim number 4 or 5; she is frozen in the same scene as Uva. (3) Eye colour: green/olive in most reports, 'green or blue' in one.

characters.name: Naranja ('Naranjita')
characters.role: Cherry's neighbour, whom Cherry can't stand. She is the sixth victim and the 'naranja' flavour. Cherry freezes her on her own initiative without consulting Cocardo, which starts their power struggle.
characters.appearance: SKIN: warm orange. HAIR: big, voluminous golden-orange curly hair made of spiralling orange-peel ribbons, with small green leaves and tiny white orange blossoms on top. EYES: large and light hazel-green/brown (frosted blue when frozen). EYEBROWS: orange-brown. LIPS: peachy, with a big friendly smile. OUTFIT: cream/white sweetheart tank top, brown belt, cuffed light-wash denim shorts (some reports say jeans). JEWELLERY: gold hoop earrings, thin gold necklace, gold bracelets, a watch. PROP: homemade 'panecitos', shown in a creator frame as a brown paper bag of muffins. NOTE: a different, cartoonish round-orange MALE customer in a teal T-shirt appears in crowd scenes and is not Naranja.
characters.personality: Very friendly, chatty and a little pushy; she keeps bringing baked goods. Cherry calls her 'insoportable'.
characters.story_arc: Cherry, pitching flavours: 'tengo una vecina naranja, nunca me cayó bien.' In Cherry's backstory she brings rolls every day ('vecina, te traje panecitos calientitos'). The freezing scene: 'Cherry, justo iba a tocarte' / 'Qué sorpresa, hice panecitos otra vez' / '¿Quieres pasar un ratito?' / '¿Sabes con qué quedarían bien esos panecitos? ...Con leche... acompáñame a la cocina' / 'Buenas noches, naranjita.' Cocardo: '¿Qué hiciste?' / 'Es mi vecina' / 'Cherry, no necesitamos más sabores' / 'Tú no la conoces, es insoportable, solo quise darle un uso' / 'No puedes traer gente aquí sin consultarme' / '¿Funcionó, no?' / 'Métela en el congelador viejo.' Customers order 'uno de naranja' and it sells well. P9: Cocardo complains that Cherry 'trajiste a naranjita cuando ni siquiera necesitábamos otro sabor.'
characters.conflicts: (1) Part number: Part 7 in two reports, Part 8 in one; the boundaries for Parts 2-8 are unverified. (2) Speaker of 'buenas noches, naranjita': Cherry in four reports, Cocardo in one. In the subtitles it comes right before Cocardo's '¿qué hiciste?'. (3) Freezer: Cherry first shuts her in a white chest freezer in her own kitchen, then Cocardo says 'métela en el congelador viejo' at the shop. Reports variously said 'chest freezer' or 'old freezer'. (4) Baked goods: a paper bag of muffins (creator frame, three reports) versus a tray of cinnamon rolls (one report, from a reupload). (5) Shorts versus jeans. (6) One report wrongly gave the 'institución mental' line to Naranja; it is about Cherry. (7) It is unconfirmed whether she is shown thawing or freed in Part 13 (see open questions).

plot_timeline.summary: The creator's canon is 'La Nieve de Lima', 13 parts, all frames watermarked '@frutitaenlatada'. Parts 1-8 survive as the creator's 'Recopilación de Capítulos 1 al 8' (posted 26 Sep, 8.9M plays, about 15.6 min) and in many reuploads. Copies of Parts 1-7 already existed on 24 Sep, so the originals aired around 22-24 Sep, probably on @frutasalocadas before its suspension. Parts 9-13 were posted on @frutitaenlatada between 25 and 29 Sep. The titles of Parts 9-13 are verified on the creator's account. The titles and exact boundaries of Parts 2-8 come only from reuploads and search snippets and vary between copiers (medium/low confidence). The order of events is high confidence. Dialogue comes from TikTok auto-captions and can contain small errors. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689758454038187285 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutinovela541/video/7688937413015784725

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 1 - 'La Nieve de Lima' (the old freezer)
plot_timeline.summary: Coco's Scoops is failing ('hoy vendemos menos de lo que cuesta prender las luces' / 'entonces mañana prende menos luces'). Cocardo bought an old used freezer for 4,000 pesos (5,000 with shipping); it makes noises, shakes, smells burnt and keeps shutting off ('no está viejo, está experimentado'; 'dale un golpecito'). Lima steps in to check the cable, the door locks, and she freezes ('ya sé, ya sé, Cocardo, tengo frío'). Cocardo finds her frozen but alive, scrapes 'solo un poquito', likes the taste and sells 'helado de Lima limón'. It is a huge hit ('es orgánico', 'todo esto por la nieve de Lima', 'seremos ricos'), and Cherry is among the first customers (from frames, medium confidence). Cliffhanger: 'tu brazo... se regeneró'. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689758454038187285 , https://www.tiktok.com/@ffrutasalocadass/video/7689173160557628692 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutinovelas.1234/video/7690362599044615444

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 2 - 'Necesitamos Un Nuevo Sabor' (Fresa) [title from reuploads]
plot_timeline.summary: Demand explodes ('uno por persona, ya se me están poniendo violentos'; 'ya me están dejando sin brazo'), and customers want a new flavour, which Cocardo promises for tomorrow. Late at night Lima's cousin Fresa arrives: 'vine a ver a mi prima Lima, no me responde desde ayer'. He shows her the back room and freezes her ('lo siento Fresa, pero te necesito'; 'ya tengo un nuevo sabor para mañana'). Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689758454038187285 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutasalocadas001/video/7689620202836872462 , https://www.razon.com.mx/entretenimiento/2026/09/26/las-frutinovelas-son-canceladas-por-mostrar-historias-canibales-en-tiktok/

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 3 - Don Piña's deal [title uncertain; 'El Negocio Del Siglo' is attached to Part 3, 5 or 8 depending on the copier]
plot_timeline.summary: '¡Pásele, pásele! Tenemos la famosa nieve de Lima y el nuevo sabor de fresa' ('receta familiar'). The millionaire Don Piña arrives in a black Rolls-Royce with his bodyguard ('¿Tú eres Cocardo?' / 'Depende quién pregunte'). He tastes both flavours: 'Necesito 500 l para empezar... 500 por sabor... Consígueme 5 y tenemos un trato.' Cocardo decides he needs a bigger freezer. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitasenlatada1/video/7690344156274658580 , https://www.tiktok.com/@fruti.novelas.com358/video/7691398043396099346 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689758454038187285

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 4 - 'Voy A Ampliar El Menú' (new freezer, Durazna) [title from reuploads]
plot_timeline.summary: The broccoli delivery man installs a big walk-in/glass freezer ('¿para qué quiere tanto espacio?' / 'voy a ampliar el menú'), and Cocardo keeps the old one. He moves the girls ('con cuidado chicas, no quiero que se me rompa el inventario'). Customers ask for durazno, plátano and uva morada. He lures Durazna with 'helado gratis de por vida' and freezes her ('estoy a tres sabores de cerrar el mejor trato de mi vida... tú serás el tercero... tres de 5'). Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutasalocadas001/video/7689625214770023693 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutinovela541/video/7688937413015784725

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 5 - Uva and Banana, the fake job offer
plot_timeline.summary: At the counter a cherry flavour is floated to Cherry ('¿y a ti no te gustaría uno de cereza?'). Cocardo offers jobs to newcomer Uva and to Banana, who was just fired ('pásate esta noche a la hora del cierre'). Piña asks '¿cómo van mis nuevos sabores?'. At closing he shows both women the walk-in ('aquí sucede la magia... entren y véanlo de cerca'), pushes them in, and says 'perfecto, ya están los 5'. The five flavours are now lima, fresa, durazno, uva and plátano. One reupload's caption: 'detective está al tanto de la desaparición de las frutas'. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689758454038187285 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutasalocadas001/video/7689630947179760909

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 6 - 'Cherry Conoce El Negocio' [title from the Dailymotion reupload]
plot_timeline.summary: Cherry: 'lo del helado de cereza, quiero que lo hagas'. Cocardo: 'Cherry, no abra ese congelador.' She opens it, sees the frozen girls ('mira, ahí está Banana... esto es hermoso') and proposes a partnership ('tienes 5 sabores que nadie más puede hacer... yo te ayudo a convertir esto en un imperio'). Banano reads a 'missing fruit women' newspaper at night ('otra vez no... esto me resulta demasiado familiar'). The longer early version includes a meta joke about copycats ('pueden copiar el menú, los colores, hasta los nombres'). Sources: https://www.dailymotion.com/video/xbcdye6 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutasalocadas001/video/7689636629559921933 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutiinovelas54/video/7688916567454797076

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 7 - triple deal, Banano at the shop, Naranja ['Cherry Special' title unverified; one report places Naranja in Part 8]
plot_timeline.summary: Piña tastes all 5. Cherry: 'queremos el triple'; Piña: 'me agradas, denos el triple'. Banano comes to the shop looking for his sister and is served plátano ('demasiado familiar... mi hermana también era banana'). A briefcase of dollars arrives ('todo esto salió de un día'; 'no me hizo socia, yo vi una oportunidad'). Cherry pitches new flavours and jokes '¿y helado de coco cremosito?... bromi'. A flashback shows her boring office job and her neighbour Naranja. Cherry lures Naranja with 'panecitos... con leche' and freezes her ('buenas noches, naranjita'). Cocardo is angry ('métela en el congelador viejo'), but orange sells. Banano finds a file showing Cherry was in a mental institution. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689758454038187285 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutasalocadas001/video/7689644411730414862 , https://www.tiktok.com/@cocardo.frutasalocadas/video/7689851515481247009

A storm cuts the power ('si se descongelan, se acabó el negocio'). Roll call: 'Lima, fresa, durazno, banana... ¿dónde está Uva?'. Uva thaws, hides, runs through the rain and asks Cherry for help ('un hombre me encerró en un congelador'). Cherry walks her back ('aquí termina el paseo... se acabó, Uva') and she is refrozen. The order is late. Piña: 'creí que eras un hombre de palabra' / 'una noche de retraso no va a destruir su imperio' / 'no, pero los malos hábitos sí'. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689758454038187285 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutasalocadas001/video/7689644104753433869 , https://www.tunota.com/entretenimiento/cocardo-y-sus-helados-frutinovela-completa-que-paso-con-lima-y-cereza-2026-09-25

Banano tails Piña's Rolls-Royce, scuffles with the bodyguard ('solo quiero respuestas') and hears 'mientras cumplan con el pedido no es asunto mío'. Cocardo and Cherry fight for control ('yo tenía el control antes de que llegaras' / 'no, Cocardo, tenías suerte'). Cherry daydreams about freezing Cocardo into coconut ice cream. They scrape Lima to recover the lost stock ('raspa más rápido'). Banano reviews CCTV of Uva leaving a store with Cherry ('así que estabas ahí'). Source: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7689599098525191444

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 10 - 'Lo Que Esconden Atrás' (27 Sep, about 18.3M plays)
plot_timeline.summary: Cherry spots Banano's car ('es de Banano, el hermano de Banana'). Cocardo installs security cameras. Cherry pushes for a second branch ('otra sucursal') and Cocardo refuses ('más gente haciendo preguntas'). On a night stakeout a homeless lemon tells Banano that 'el coco y la cereza tienen algo grande escondido en los congeladores'. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7690040077141150996 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutinovelas.1234/video/7690267614299442453

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 11 - 'Final Demasiado Cerca' (27 Sep, about 12.1M plays)
plot_timeline.summary: The strawberry police officer scolds Banano. Cocardo and Cherry see an intruder on camera ('tenemos que hacer algo con Banano'). Banano finds Banana's bracelet behind the shop ('esta pulsera se la regalé yo... hermana, estuviste aquí') and the officer wants a warrant. Cherry: 'deja de temblar y piensa.' Banano drives to Coco's Scoops. Evidence chain for a game: newspaper, then Cherry's file, then CCTV recording, then the homeless tip, then the bracelet. Sources: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7690290470227823878 , https://www.tiktok.com/@frutinovelas.1234/video/7690293559215377684

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 12 - 'El Último En Pie' (28 Sep, about 8.2M plays)
plot_timeline.summary: Banano crashes his car into the shop, cutting the freezers' power ('así que tú eres Cocardo... ¿dónde está mi hermana?'). Cherry tries to restore the power and Banano knocks her out ('una menos'). At the station, police dispatch 'todas las que estén cerca'. Cocardo gains the upper hand ('te vas a reunir con ella pronto... helado de plátano con chocolate'). Source: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7690460851345607957

plot_timeline.stage: Parte 13 - 'Se Acabó El Sabor' (29 Sep, about 23.9M plays; the creator's finale)
plot_timeline.summary: Cocardo pins Banano ('te llegó la hora... los años ya te están pesando' / 'todavía sé pegar, pero cada vez más despacio'). The freezers thaw ('se están descongelando'). Durazna (with a pipe), Banana, Uva and Fresa surround Cocardo ('quítense'). Lima appears ('Lima. Mi amor, eres tú.' / 'Ya no más') and Cocardo is knocked out. A watermelon cop cuffs him ('arrestamos al culpable' / 'el culpable son dos... Cherry'). The TV reporter announces the arrest and that police seek Cherry. Piña smashes his glass ('¡Idiota!... Cherry... interesante'). Cherry, in a white hat, dress and sunglasses, buys a plane ticket with cash. Banano and Banana reunite ('siempre iba a venir por ti'). Fresa and Lima reflect ('a veces lo descubres demasiado tarde'). Final shot: Cocardo in a straitjacket and mask in a cell guarded by the watermelon cop, as a shadowy figure approaches (open cliffhanger). Source: https://www.tiktok.com/@frutitaenlatada/video/7690818489304501525

plot_timeline.stage: Real world - suspension and 'Cocardo murió' hoaxes (25 Sep - 11 Oct)
plot_timeline.summary: Mid-story, TikTok suspended @frutasalocadas (3.4M+ followers) without an official reason. Media link the suspension to mass reports over fruit 'canibalismo', but say this is unconfirmed. Death hoaxes followed: a car crash, frozen in his own shop, shot, fake funerals. TuNota traces the rumour to the Facebook page of Marco Odagled. Radio HRN, Milenio, El Comercio, DSN, Exitosa and cocardo.com debunk them. Sources: https://www.razon.com.mx/entretenimiento/2026/09/26/las-frutinovelas-son-canceladas-por-mostrar-historias-canibales-en-tiktok/ , https://www.radiohrn.hn/cocardo-murio-hoy-2026-es-verdad-que-fallecio-el-personaje-de-frutinovelas-2026-09-25 , https://www.tunota.com/entretenimiento/quien-es-cocardo-el-malvado-heladero-de-las-frutinovelas-con-ia-de-tiktok-2026-09-25 , https://www.elgrafico.mx/espectaculos/2026/10/11/cocardo-y-su-frutinovela-corre-peligro-le-tumban-la-cuenta-de-tiktok-al-creador-de-la-novela/

plot_timeline.stage: NON-CANON - press version (Cereza frames Cocardo; prison escape)
plot_timeline.summary: TuNota (25 Sep, written before Parts 10-13 existed) says Cereza falsified evidence and planted illegal goods, Cocardo went to prison, and she took over the shop. El Gráfico (5 Oct) says she 'quedó libre y tomó el control del negocio' and that Cocardo later escaped prison and hid in a police station in a police uniform; cocardo.com repeats this. None of it is in the creator's 13 parts. It matches fan uploads such as Pixafree's 'Cocardo serie completa casi lo atrapan' ('se escondió en la comisaría'). Sources: https://www.tunota.com/entretenimiento/cocardo-y-sus-helados-frutinovela-completa-que-paso-con-lima-y-cereza-2026-09-25 , https://www.elgrafico.mx/espectaculos/2026/10/05/que-paso-con-cocardo-el-capitulo-mas-turbio-de-la-frutinovela-que-tiene-a-tiktok-en-suspenso/ , https://cocardo.com/historia-completa/ , https://www.dailymotion.com/video/xbi1nue

(a) @verdugo_frutisnovela / @frutirelatoss_ fan 'Parte 9 El Helado Multi-Sabor': Piña frozen, a 'sabor multifruta' and 'polibananos' police; this is probably the source of TuNota's 'Piña is a victim'. setting_and_style: SHOP: 'COCO'S SCOOPS'. The English name appears on the sign, Cocardo's apron, the cups and the TV chyron. It is a red-brick corner storefront on a New-York-like street (brick walk-ups, fire escapes, café tables). EXTERIOR: pink script 'Coco's Scoops' sign with an ice-cream-cone icon; striped awning, pink/red-and-white in most shots and tan/brown-and-white in others (AI inconsistency); glass doors; pink neon at night. INTERIOR: pastel pink walls with ice-cream-cone wallpaper, mint/sage-green wainscoting, a pink neon sign, pendant lamps, a white/wood/marble counter, and a curved glass display case of steel pans in flavour colours (lime green, strawberry pink, peach, banana cream-yellow, grape purple, orange). Also menu boards with cone pictures, logo cups and litre tubs, glass sundae coupes, cones and a counter bell. LOGO: a round badge reading 'COCO'S SCOOPS' around a half-coconut bowl holding pink, teal and yellow scoops, with a small palm tree. BACK KITCHEN/STOREROOM: stainless-steel tables and bowls, wire shelving, tubs, cardboard boxes, condenser units, pink-tiled walls and an emergency exit; from P10, security cameras and a CCTV monitor. FREEZERS: (1) 'el congelador viejo', a battered, rusty, dented off-white upright single-door freezer with a bottom vent grille, a frosty blue-white interior and a bare bulb. It is noisy, shakes, smells burnt and its door jams. It cost 4,000 pesos (5,000 with shipping). Lima and Fresa sit inside hugging their knees, and Cocardo keeps it after the upgrade (Naranja goes in it). (2) The big new freezer from P4, a blue-lit steel walk-in or tall glass-door cold room where the five girls stand frozen in a row behind frosted glass. (3) A white chest freezer in Cherry's apartment kitchen (Naranja). WORLD RULES (from the dialogue): frozen fruit people stay alive and conscious. Cocardo scrapes them with an ice-cream scoop and the scraped parts regenerate ('tu brazo se regeneró'). A power cut thaws them and a thawed fruit can walk out ('si se descongelan, se acabó el negocio'). All victims survive. MONEY: pesos for the freezer; US-dollar bundles in black briefcases for Piña's orders. OTHER LOCATIONS: Don Piña's black Rolls-Royce and his dark wood-panelled mansion office with TV and whisky; Banano's black classic 1960s muscle car and night office (skyline window, newspapers, case files, polaroids, CCTV computer); Cherry's office (filing cabinets, stamps) and apartment; rainy night streets and a convenience store; an alley with bins and cardboard; a police station with fruit-headed cops; a TV news report outside the wrecked shop; an airport check-in; a prison corridor and cell. VISUAL STYLE: glossy Pixar/Disney-like 3D CGI, clearly AI-generated (the creator tags #pixverseai; PixVerse as the tool is low confidence). Vertical 9:16 (about 576x1024), warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, textured glossy skins (coconut fibre, citrus pores, strawberry seeds, pineapple scales). DESIGN RULE: the male leads (Cocardo, Don Piña, Banano), the cops and most extras have a whole-fruit head with a human face on a human body. The female fruit characters (Lima, Fresa, Durazna, Uva, Banana, Naranja, Cherry) are stylised curvy young women (a Bratz/Pixar hybrid) with fruit-coloured, textured skin, fruit-themed hair, big glossy eyes, long lashes and gold jewellery (hoops, layered necklaces). Exceptions: the strawberry police officer and the TV reporter are women with fruit heads. AUDIO/TEXT: AI voices in Latin-American (Mexican-sounding) Spanish ('pásele, pásele', 'nieve' for ice cream); burned-in white Spanish captions in the lower centre; a faint '@frutitaenlatada' watermark; parts of about 2-3.5 minutes ending on cliffhangers. creator_and_controversy: CREATOR: anonymous; no real name is public. Press (El Gráfico, DSN, Exitosa, MTP, La Razón, cocardo.com) names TikTok @frutasalocadas as the original account. Exitosa's screenshot shows 'user73599220502 @frutasalocadas' with 3.4M followers and 46.1M likes. TikTok suspended it around 25-26 Sep 2026 with no official reason, and it now returns statusCode 10221. Every original frame, Parts 1-13, carries the watermark '@frutitaenlatada'. That account ('Las FrutiNovelas 2', created 17 Aug 2026, about 1.5M followers and 12.5M likes) has the bio 'cuenta de respaldo @frutitassinverguenza / los vídeos diarios volverán pronto' and links to Facebook 'frutassinverguenza'. It posted Parts 9-13 (25-29 Sep), the 'Recopilación 1 al 8' (26 Sep) and the spin-off 'El Sabor De Tus Secretos' (2-14 Oct). Evidence the accounts are linked: @frutitaenlatada6's bio ('Me eliminaron la Cuenta Original de Frutasalocadas... 2 cuenta @Frutitaenlatada'); @frutasalocadas001 (created 25 Sep, 'CUENTA PRINCIPAL EN RECUPERACIÓN... NO TENGO MÁS CUENTAS') tagging @Frutitaenlatada; and La Unión: 'la creadora de contenido Frutitas enlatadas, quien se atribuye la autoría de esta historia'. Radio HRN credits 'Frutinovelas' / 'frutasalocadas'. No source explicitly confirms that @frutasalocadas and @frutitaenlatada are the same person. CONTROVERSY: viewers read the plot as fictional fruit 'canibalismo', and the suspension is widely blamed on mass reports (unconfirmed). Death hoaxes followed ('Falleció Cocardo, el famoso heladero': car crash, frozen, shot, fake funerals; TuNota traces them to the Facebook page of Marco Odagled), debunked by Radio HRN, Milenio, El Comercio, DSN, Exitosa and cocardo.com. Many copycat and reupload accounts claim to be official (@ffrutasalocadass, @frutinovelas.1234, @frutinovela541, @cocardo.frutasalocadas, @verdugo_frutisnovela, @sisoyfrosti, @frutasalocados, Pixafree on Dailymotion), and fan continuations blur canon. El Gráfico (11 Oct) warns the story may 'terminar perdida entre cientos de versiones hechas por los propios fans'. The wider frutinovela trend has drawn warnings about its effect on children. Press summaries (TuNota, El Gráfico) contradict the videos on Cereza's betrayal and the prison escape. REACH: Part 13 had about 23.9M plays, Part 10 18.3M, Part 11 12.1M, Part 9 9.1M, Part 12 8.2M, and the 1-8 compilation 8.9M. El Comercio, citing Milenio, says some episodes passed 50M. REAL-WORLD TIE-IN: Gallelatto, an ice-cream shop in Maracaibo, Venezuela, displayed cardboard cut-outs of Cocardo (apron, serving spoon), Cherry and Banano; the reel passed about 2.3M views (Merca2.0, 6 Oct). cocardo.com is an unofficial fan site with no relation to the creators ('Cocardo y los demás personajes pertenecen a sus autores').
